columns: Primary key. Unique identifier for the user.
Object describing how the user was acquired. Contains a `link` key with the referral or attribution URL.
ISO country code for the country the user sends money from (e.g. `GB`, `US`, `DE`).
Timestamp when the user was approved to transact (post-KYC). Null if not yet approved.
Device and client metadata set by the mobile app.
Foreign key to the invitation code used at signup. Null if no code was used.
URL to the user's profile image. Null if not set.
Object containing user usage preferences. Contains `sender_country` and `recipient_countries` keys.
Foreign key to `users.id`. The user who owns this account.
Feature flags and capabilities enabled for this account.
Timestamp when the account was created.
Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.
Reference to the account's profile configuration.
The transaction limit tier assigned to this account.
Timestamp when the account was soft-deleted by the application. Null if the account is active.
Foreign key to `users.id`. The user who initiated the transaction.
Foreign key to `users_account.id`. The account the transaction belongs to.
The amount the sender sent, in `sent_currency`.
ISO currency code of the sending currency (e.g. `GBP`, `USD`, `EUR`).
The amount the recipient receives, in `received_currency`.
ISO currency code of the receiving currency (e.g. `KES`, `TZS`, `NGN`, `UGX`).
The exchange rate applied to this transaction (1 unit of sent_currency = exchange_rate units of received_currency).
The original amount before fees, in the sending currency.
Foreign key to `transactions_recipient.id`. The recipient of this transaction. Null for non-disbursement types.
Foreign key to `transactions_recipient_account.id`. The specific payment destination. Null for non-disbursement types.
Foreign key to the approval workflow, if the transaction requires one. Null for most transactions.
Timestamp when the transaction was created.
Timestamp of the most recent state change.
Timestamp when the transaction offer expires if not completed.
Optional note from the sender to the recipient.
Foreign key to `wallets.id`. The wallet the funds are collected from. Null for card-funded transactions.
Foreign key to `wallets.id`. The wallet the funds are disbursed to. Null for bank/mobile money payouts.

Structured summary of the transaction. Contains nested objects: `original.source_amount.amount` (float, the pre-fee amount), `fees` (array of fee objects, each with `definition.label` and `definition.kind`).
Provider-specific metadata. Structure varies by payment method.
Display label for the primary fee (e.g. `Transfer fee`).
Foreign key to `users_account.id`. The account being collected for.
ISO currency code of the collection amount.
Foreign key to `wallets.id`. The wallet the collected funds are credited to.
Timestamp when the collection was created.
Timestamp of the most recent state change.
The amount being disbursed in the destination currency.
ISO currency code of the disbursement amount.
Foreign key to `transactions_recipient_account.id`. The specific payment destination.
The name of the payout provider handling this disbursement (e.g. `THUNES`, `TERRAPAY`, `CELLULANT`).
Timestamp when the disbursement was created.
Timestamp of the most recent state change.
The payout provider used for this attempt.
The provider's internal reference for this attempt.
How this provider was chosen for the attempt. Values: `PREDEFINED`, `PRIORITY_ORDER`, `SMART_ROUTING`, `PROBING`.
Standardised classification of the provider failure reason. Null on success.
Timestamp when the attempt was initiated.
Timestamp of the most recent state change.
Estimated time of arrival for the payout.
Maximum expected delivery time. Used for SLA monitoring.
Error message from the system, if the attempt failed. Null on success.
Error message returned by the provider, if any. Null on success.
Provider-issued receipt or confirmation number. Null until completed.
The PSP (payment service provider) account used for routing.
Foreign key to `users_account.id`. The account that created this recipient.
Timestamp when the recipient was created.
Timestamp of the most recent update.
Primary key. Unique recipient account identifier.
ISO country code of the recipient's country.
ISO currency code of the destination currency.
Recipient's phone number (for mobile money). Null for non-mobile-money types.
Mobile money operator name (e.g. `MPESA`, `AIRTEL`, `MTN`). Null for non-mobile-money types.
Bank account number or identifier. Null for non-bank types.
Bank identifier code. Null for non-bank types.
Name of the bank. Null for non-bank types.
Timestamp when the recipient account was created.
Timestamp of the most recent update.
The service that created the task. Values: `fincrime`, `compliance`, `support`.
Task type, specific to the service (e.g. `user_review`, `transaction_review`, `escalation`).
The staff member who created the task. Null for system-generated tasks.
The staff member currently assigned to the task. Null if unassigned.
Array of entity IDs related to the task. Index 0 is typically the primary entity (user_id or transaction_id). Index 2 (when present) is the user_id for transaction tasks.
Task content and context. Contains keys like `disbursement_id`, `account_id`, `provider_name` depending on the task type.
Timestamp when the task was created.
Timestamp of the most recent update.
Resolution outcome. Values: `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `ESCALATED`. Null while open.
Primary key. Unique rule version identifier.
Detailed description of what the rule checks.
The team responsible for this rule.
Timestamp when this version was created.
Timestamp of the most recent update.
Timestamp when this rule version was soft-deleted. Null if active.
Primary key. Unique workflow version identifier.
Workflow configuration. Contains a `nodes` array where each node has `type` (e.g. `RULE`) and `config.rule_id` referencing a rule.
Timestamp when this version was created.
Timestamp of the most recent update.
Timestamp when this workflow version was soft-deleted. Null if active.
Foreign key to `workflows.id`. The workflow that was executed.

The business context for this execution. Contains `user_id` (string, references `Source 1 users.id`) and `transaction_id` (string, references `Source 1 transactions_transaction.id`). One or both may be present depending on the trigger event.
Timestamp when the execution was initiated.
Error details if the execution failed due to a system error. Null on success.
Array of actions triggered by this execution (e.g. `BLOCK_USER`, `HOLD_TRANSACTION`, `CREATE_TASK`).
Primary key. Unique rule execution identifier.
Foreign key to `rules.id`. The rule that was evaluated.
Foreign key to `workflow_executions.id`. The parent workflow execution.
The raw result of the condition evaluation.
Timestamp when the rule evaluation started.
Error details if the rule evaluation failed. Null on success.
Review status, if the rule execution was reviewed. Values: `PENDING`, `REVIEWED`. Null if no review is required.
Comment left by the reviewer. Null if not reviewed.
The staff member who reviewed this execution. Null if not reviewed.
Timestamp when the review was completed. Null if not reviewed.
The staff member who performed the review.
Detailed comment explaining the reviewer's determination.
Timestamp when the review was completed.
Primary key. Unique event identifier assigned by Amplitude.
The NALA user ID (matches `Source 1 users.id`). Null for anonymous events before the user logs in or creates an account.
Unique device identifier. Present for all events including anonymous ones.
Timestamp of the event on the client device.
Event-specific properties. Structure varies by event type.
User properties at the time of the event. May contain `email`, `account_status`, `plan_type`, `signup_date`.
ISO country code derived from the user's IP address.
City name derived from IP geolocation.
Version of the NALA app that generated the event.
Session identifier grouping events within a single app session.
Timestamp when Amplitude's servers received the event.
